name: OpenShift Essentials Practice
description: The OpenShift Essentials Practice provides a structured methodology for deploying, configuring, and operating Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.21. It builds upon the Platform Adoption Kernel to provide specific guidance for cluster installation, post-installation configuration, and application lifecycle management.

alphas.name: OpenShift Cluster
alphas.description: The specific realization of an OpenShift Container Platform environment, including control plane and compute nodes.

states.name: Infrastructure Prepared
states.description: The underlying compute, storage, and network resources are ready for the installer.

checklist.name: Load balancers provisioned for control plane and ingress
Firewall rules allowing required port communication established
Identity and Access Management (IAM) roles for installer created

states.name: Bootstrap Complete
states.description: The temporary bootstrap node has successfully initialized the control plane.

checklist.name: Bootstrap node successfully pulled ignition files
Etcd cluster formed among master nodes
API server is reachable on port 6443
Bootstrap node can be safely decommissioned

states.name: Cluster Functional
states.description: The control plane is stable and the initial worker nodes have joined.

alphas.name: OpenShift Workload
alphas.description: The containerized applications and services deployed and managed within the OpenShift cluster.

states.name: Namespace Established
states.description: A dedicated Project/Namespace exists with appropriate isolation and quotas.

checklist.name: RBAC roles assigned to developer groups

states.name: Deployment Validated
states.description: Workload artifacts are running and meeting initial health checks.

checklist.name: Pods are in 'Running' state across multiple nodes
Liveness and Readiness probes are passing
Service and Route objects created and resolvable

states.name: Service Optimized
states.description: Workload resource consumption is tuned based on telemetry.

checklist.name: Pod disruption budgets configured for high availability

workProducts.name: OpenShift Install Config
workProducts.description: The install-config.yaml file used to drive the openshift-install binary.

levelsOfDetail.name: Drafted
levelsOfDetail.description: The configuration includes target platform, base domain, and cluster name.

checklist.name: Base domain and cluster name specified
SSH public key for debugging included

levelsOfDetail.name: Validated
levelsOfDetail.description: The configuration has passed pre-flight schema and network checks.

checklist.name: openshift-install create manifests returns no errors
Networking parameters (CIDR ranges) verified for no conflicts

workProducts.name: Cluster Manifest Bundle
workProducts.description: The collection of YAML manifests for core cluster configuration including Auth, Networking, and Storage.

levelsOfDetail.name: Baselined
levelsOfDetail.description: Core identity and networking manifests defined.

checklist.name: HTPasswd or OIDC OAuth provider configured

levelsOfDetail.name: Hardened
levelsOfDetail.description: Security policies and governance controls applied to the manifest set.

checklist.name: Security Context Constraints (SCC) reviewed and restricted

activities.name: Design Cluster Architecture
activities.description: Define the topology, sizing, and networking for the OpenShift environment.

activities.name: Perform Cluster Installation
activities.description: Execute the OpenShift installation program to provision the infrastructure and control plane.

activities.name: Configure Day-2 Services
activities.description: Establish authentication, storage, and observability after the initial cluster is running.

patterns.name: OpenShift Deployment Journey
patterns.description: The sequential journey of establishing a production-ready OpenShift cluster.

patternViews.name: Planning and Preparation
patternViews.description: Identifying requirements and preparing the infrastructure foundations.

patternViews.name: Core Installation
patternViews.description: Executing the deployment and validating the control plane health.

patternViews.name: Stability and Onboarding
patternViews.description: Configuring post-install services and enabling developer consumption.

workBreakdowns.description: The discrete tasks required for a standard Installer-Provisioned Infrastructure (IPI) deployment.

complexity.description: Standard cloud deployment with integrated networking.
